docs.title: Rugby7 Referee Fatigue Analyzer
docs.text: Scientific software for analysing fatigue and match demands in Rugby Sevens referees.

docs.title: Main features
docs.text:
• Subjective fatigue analysis.
  • Match-demand analysis.
  • Research mode with private local data.
  • Demonstration mode with anonymized data.
  • Automated scientific reports.
  • Heatmaps and spatial visualizations.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
From the project directory, run:

python main.py

Select one execution mode:

  1. Research mode: uses the private local database.
  2. Demonstration mode: uses the public anonymized database.

Then select normal or detailed output.

docs.title: Results
docs.text: The software can generate statistical summaries, fatigue indicators, match-demand analyses, heatmaps and automated reports.
